verdict.rationale: The API supports core workflows also available in the UI—creating sessions/tasks, sending messages, requiring plan approval, generating diffs, and automating PR creation—and a community user built a working integration (MCP server) atop it, showing real parity for the main task lifecycle. However, there's no documentation or evidence confirming full feature parity (e.g., GitHub label-based task assignment, settings/API-key management, usage-limit configuration) is API-accessible, and probes show no public OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, undercutting claims of complete API/UI equivalence. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation for all UI-only features (labels, settings, notifications) and a discoverable OpenAPI schema confirming API completeness.
